ModMetaData.name: Autonomous Colonists (Experimental)
ModMetaData.author: Community prototype
ModMetaData.description: Autonomous Director v0.4 experimental for RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10). Opt-in, Balanced profile by default. Deterministic food, rest and safety proposals only; no new automatic job execution. Observation mode suspends priority writes. Preserves the independent v0.3 work manager, specialist coverage, manual locks, exclusions and conditional restoration. No changes to schedules, food policies, medical settings, apparel, drafting or zones. External Work Manager suspends priority automation. Compiled against private 1.7 libraries; actual game and Android validation pending. Read INSTALAR.md before testing.
